item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 1 #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:30 AM 04 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Cebu(CebuCity, CityOfTalisay), #Palawan(Rizal and Brooke'sPoint) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Bataraza and ElNido) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
